tree.pilotdeck.yaml:
schemaVersion: 1
telemetry:
  enabled: false
adapters:
  wecom:
    enabled: true
    token: fixture-bot-id
    extra:
      secret: fixture-bot-secret
      websocket_url: wss://fixture.invalid/ws
      dm_policy: allowlist
      group_policy: allowlist
      allow_from:
        - user-a
        - user-b
      group_allow_from:
        - group-a
        - group-b
      groups:
        group-a:
          requireMention: false
  weixin:
    enabled: false
    obsolete: keep-until-setup

重启 PilotDeck 服务后生效。
